notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Available Now for Free!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/6428763e3d9b4152c6bdb8e5f529f05ea666cc4e.png[/img]

We've just released a major update for Chess Knights: High Noon! 

It is a completely new story, with new characters, new mechanics and scenarios.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/932e59cd1eab95ac91260397e1dee183f72ffe74.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/d3d9964dc4753b2e017364f776b6cbefa51aa140.png[/img]

Together with this content update, we've also fixed several minor issues, added a help guide and other features to make the experience great for you.

You can update your game and start playing it right away. 

And if you still does not own a copy of Chess Knights: High Noon, you can get it for only $1.99:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486800/Chess_Knights_High_Noon/

Chess Knights: High Noon is here. Play it now!
notes.notes:
We're very pleased to announce the launch of a new game in the Chess Knights series!

In [b]Chess Knights: High Noon[/b] you are one of the deadliest gunslinger of the Old West. Use your instincts and fast trigger skills to hunt and kill all the Wanted Ones. Do it for fame or simply for a fistful of dollars.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/0c3f3b19146591a007851926f32071b7b1b6a30b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/a8b37869d09e0c25832bb1f3c544df0828780ce6.jpg[/img]

Get it now while the launch discount lasts and have fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486800/Chess_Knights_High_Noon/

notes.title: Chess Knights: Shinobi is here! Play it now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/79363fb101214ec8952db97dfeec4859af028894.jpg[/img]

[b]How stealthily can you move?
[/b]

Today we launch the Early Access version of Chess Knights: Shinobi!

We are very happy with this launch and hoping you like this game as much as we do. A lot of care were put into it!

If you like puzzle games even a bit, do not hesitate in buying this game because the launch price is as low as it will ever be.

This is our way to thank for the incredible support you have given to Minimol Games!

So go get it and don't forget to leave us a review if you like it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383050/Chess_Knights_Shinobi/

Have fun!
.
